≈10 min (plus the trip through the Hero Cave)

Deep in Edron's Hero Cave there is a room guarded by a {creature:Demon}. Inside a coffin is a bag with the {item:Key 6010} and other items, but when you touch the yellow parchment on top, 4 more Demons appear. Kill them or grab the prize and run.
Someone has set a dangerous trap to protect an important key.
No minimum level, but the recommended level is **120** — you have to kill (or run from) up to **5 Demons**.
to open the hole in the Hero Cave
Plenty of potions and preparation to face {creature:Demon|Demons}
Demon Hell (door after the Gate of Expertise)
The {item:Key 6010} (golden key) you take from the coffin opens the door right after the Gate of Expertise, in Edron's {wiki:Hero Cave}.
The key is an item: you have to take it with you. You also need level 100 (Gate of Expertise) and two players on the switches to open the wall further ahead.
The {item:Key 6010} is needed to reach the quest room, inside Demon Hell.
In the room there is 1 Demon right at the entrance and 4 more appear when you touch the parchment: in total you may have to deal with **5 Demons**.
If you can't kill the 4 extra Demons, open the coffin, grab the prize and run.

If you aren't in Edron, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain of your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port of **Edron**, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the port, go **north** to the entrance of the {wiki:Hero Cave|Hero Cave}, north of the city.
Go to **Edron** and enter the {wiki:Hero Cave|Hero Cave}.

In the Hero Cave there are {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians} and {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}.
Follow the path to the hole
Follow the path shown in the image to the spot of the hole.
Path inside the Hero Cave to the hole
Use the {item:Pick} on the ground to open the hole and go down.
The spot where you use the pick

Down there, go **west**. You find a gravestone and a teleport to a big room with a {creature:Demon} inside: the **Parchment Room**. The stone says *"De.th to those who disturb ..e slumber of .ath.."*, i.e. *"Death to those who disturb the slumber of Father"*.
Prepare well to face the Demon before you step into the teleport.
Step into the teleport and kill the {creature:Demon} in the room.
Go to the coffin in the **middle** of the room. On top of it is a {item:Yellow Parchment} ({item:Buried Forever (Book)|Buried Forever}). When you push/touch it, **4 Demons** appear around you.
The Parchment Room with the coffin in the middle
The 4 Demons appear around you. Have your potions and your escape planned before you touch the parchment.

Now you decide: kill the Demons or grab the reward and run. Either way, you have to **open the coffin** to get the reward: a {item:Brown Bag} with the {item:Key 6010}, a {item:Bone}, a {item:Stealth Ring}, 2 {item:Talon|Talons} and a {item:Skull (Item)|Skull}.
Brown Bag with Key 6010, Bone, Stealth Ring, 2 Talons and Skull

To leave, go back the **same way** (the wiki doesn't describe a separate exit teleport from the Parchment Room): return to the gravestone area, use the {item:Rope} on the hole you opened with the {item:Pick} to go up, and retrace the path in the image backwards to the Hero Cave entrance. Outside, go **south** to the city of **Edron**; to leave the island, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the port ({key:hi}, the name of the city, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
If you ran away without killing the Demons, they are still in the room: get out quickly and watch out for the Hero Cave respawn on the way back.
